import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n, m, mod = map(int, data)

    comb = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    comb[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        comb[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % mod

    f = [0] * (n + 1)
    g = [0] * (n + 1)
    f[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            k = i - j - 1
            f[i] = (f[i] + f[j] * f[k] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * comb[i - 1][j]) % mod
            g[i] = (g[i] + g[j] * f[k] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * comb[i - 1][j]) % mod
            g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * g[k] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * comb[i - 1][j]) % mod
            g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * f[k] % mod * comb[i - 1][j] % mod * (((j * (j + 1)) // 2) + ((k * (k + 1)) // 2))) % mod

    dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 2)] for _ in range(n + 2)]
    dp[0][0][1] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            dp[i + 1][j][1] = (dp[i + 1][j][1] + dp[i][j][0] + dp[i][j][1]) % mod
            for k in range(n - i + 1):
                ni = i + k
                nj = j + k
                if ni <= n and nj <= n:
                    val = (dp[i][j][1] * f[k] % mod * comb[j + k][j]) % mod
                    dp[ni][nj][0] = (dp[ni][nj][0] + val) % mod

    answer = 0
    for j in range(n):
        for i in range(j + 1):
            rem = m - (j - i + 1)
            if rem < 0:
                continue
            for k in range(rem + 1):
                temp = (g[j - i + 1] * dp[i - 1][k][1] % mod * dp[n - j][rem - k][1] % mod * comb[m][rem] % mod * comb[rem][k]) % mod
                answer = (answer + temp) % mod

    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
